candidate: Preserve admitted F32 composition and add F32 storage to the existing Competitive fragment-mask path; keep per-run source conversion and its work/error ordering. Exact admission and coverage remain unchanged.
order: Five randomized warmup pairs then31 measured pairs per cell, shuffled across cells. Within each cell, measured order is16 baseline/candidate and15 candidate/baseline, then shuffled.
metric: total_ns from scene_index_profile: in-memory document open+compile_page+retained render, excluding file I/O, output emission, startup and destruction.

accuracy.candidate: All19 fixed independent RGB references in both modes, zero channel error, opaque alpha255 and correct dimensions on every output.
accuracy.baseline: Retain and report every mismatch; cost outputs must match that exact same-cell preflight output. Baseline is not assumed independently correct.

references.scope: Frozen independent analytic19 references; image sampling policies are explicit fixture models, not arbitrary PDF or continuous-scene correctness.

decision.invalid: Cancellation, contention, changed source/artifacts, missing process/RSS/stage measurements or incomplete matrix do not support a completed cost diagnostic.
decision.reject: Any candidate independent-pixel failure or new source-error/budget bypass blocks retention. Do not relax existing conformance references or resource tests to make the candidate pass.
decision.cost: This is a descriptive accuracy-cost experiment, not a confidence-bound speed/memory gate. Preserve every cell and disclose costs. Larger regressions require investigation before retaining active code.
decision.next: Full required validation and broader affected-scene/native/WASM measurements remain necessary. Rebase the preserved color allocation candidate only after the precision decision.

limitations: No shading performance or large dynamic-scene coverage.
Known baseline errors make those cell ratios accuracy costs, not equivalent-output speed superiority.
31 pairs do not establish tail behavior or confidence-bound admission.
No competitor, browser or WASM speed claim.
No full-corpus perfection or fully unified geometry/image/font policy claim.

coordination.scope: Known-process polling; no OS-level exclusivity and no cold-filesystem claim

bounds.scope: Retained PDFs/oracles/output blobs only; checkpoints and coordination evidence additional
